sentences.text: This petition is filed challenging the initiation of criminal proceedings against the petitioner, who is the owner of a hotel, in which a substandard tomato sauce is alleged to have been served to the customers.
2. The complaint indicates that, the company which was supposed to have manufactured the tomato sauce has not been arrayed as an accused.
It is therefore clear that a proceeding initiated in the absence of the company would be vitiated.
3. Consequently, the impugned proceedings initiated against the petitioner are quashed.
Accordingly, the criminal petition is allowed.
